'''''Beginnings''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted an erupting [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Beginnings'' appeared in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']],<ref name="SWG" /> a [[2005]] expansion pack<ref name="Trials">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20050819.html|text=Growing Galaxies: The Trials of Obi-Wan set for Nov. 1st}}</ref> for the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It could be used as decoration in the player's house. It was obtained by inserting three [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-infused items&mdash;a [[Shisha/Legends|shisha]], a [[recording rod]], and an ammo box&mdash;into the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] relic capable of transmogrification through the Force. These items were looted from the corpses of the various enemies found on Mustafar.<ref name="SWG" />
